title: Elbert: Fast Albert with Confidence-Window Based Early Exit
selection_reason: The abstract identifies slow inference as a resource constraint for pretrained language models and proposes confidence-window early exit for ALBERT, reporting 2x–10x adaptive inference speedup with negligible accuracy degradation.
